_comment: Transcription repairs applied between Whisper and the router.
Keys are matched case-insensitively on word boundaries, longest first.
Values are substituted verbatim, so the capitalisation here is what the
router, the read-back and the escalation all see.
Two kinds of entry live here. Names Whisper cannot spell, and shorthand Sean
says out loud that no model would map to the real thing. Both fail the same
way without this file: the router classifies a sentence that is not the one
Known cost: a real person called Jack becomes Jax. Sean has no such contact,
and the alternative is the address layer missing every second utterance.
Keys starting with an underscore are ignored, so this block is not a rule.
